summary: First engineering hire; joined the day the technical team was formed and grew with it to ~10 engineers. Reports directly to the CEO. 428 commits across 9 repositories.
bullets: Built an end-to-end Whisper fine-tuning platform — audio preprocessing (VAD via pyannote/Silero/Kaldi, Demucs separation, segment-level deduplication, augmentation, QC gates) through distributed training, checkpoint export and cloud sync. Built to operate over a corpus of 2,000 hours per language across 20 languages.

Productionized multi-GPU training on DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 across 4-GPU nodes; diagnosed and fixed NCCL collective failures, torchrun TCPStore rendezvous hangs, per-rank CUDA device binding, distributed LR-schedule desync, and multi-GPU finalize deadlocks on GCP Blackwell instances.

Orchestrated preprocessing and training with Prefect and MLflow; added GCS autoresume, hardware-aware GPU/CPU launch, a Docker Compose training operator, and pre-training readiness checks — enabling unattended multi-day runs.

Split a monolithic repository into two services: extracted the preprocessing stack, restructured it into a stage-modular architecture with its own Prefect flows and MLflow dashboard, and reduced the training repo to training concerns only.
Containerized the stack for GCP / Vertex AI and AWS, with regional Cloud Build push, CI smoke tests, and dual-cloud config parity.
Fine-tuned Whisper with PEFT/LoRA; fixed Hugging Face checkpoint export against live PEFT adapters and hardened decoder-label and validation contracts.

Wrote the founding commit of VOIT, the company's production dubbing platform, in April 2025 and stayed lead engineer as it became the company's live application. Shipped a dual-provider Voice Library with emotion variants, per-line voice variants and self-healing repair; normalized voice enrolment so a single enrolment works across providers. Cut editor page load 118x — 4,523 MB to 38 MB transferred.

Built AutoDub, a separate internal testing platform for evaluating new speech approaches. Where vendor output was unusable, ran locally hosted open models on GPU instead. Produced the first successful Iberian Spanish, Delhi-accent Hindi and UAE Arabic voice clones for client samples.

Ran the production Google Drive to S3 migration, including IAM design, S3 access points and multi-worker transfer tooling. Evaluated Wasabi against AWS and recommended AWS-only, removing a redundant storage tier.

Onboarded and trained every engineer hired after me. Owned architecture and build-vs-buy decisions; led commercial negotiations across cloud and AI suppliers; trusted with independent purchasing authority.
Built and maintained 20+ WordPress sites including the Communities Foundation of Texas (CFT) and CCRSM projects; implemented WooCommerce flows, site migrations and performance optimization.
Built responsive React interfaces to pixel-perfect designs within a function-based architecture.
